title: Eliciting and Mitigating Specification Satisficing in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description. In some of these failures, the agent considers an implementation choice that meets a requirement, but later decides to commit to another one that does not meet the requirement for a reason it finds acceptable. We call this specification satisficing. It is challenging to identify and mitigate specification satisficing because the agent accepts such choices for its own reasons, and existing self-correction methods are biased toward them. We propose SatisFix, which guides a coding agent to report these choices and their reasons, and then check each choice against the task description. We evaluate SatisFix on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Pro with five LLMs as backbones and two different agent frameworks, and compare it with three self-correction methods. SatisFix improves the pass@1 of the base agent by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-ben

translated_title: 诱发与缓解编码智能体中的“规范满意化”行为
translated_abstract: 编码智能体经常无法满足任务描述中的全部要求。在其中一些失败案例中，智能体其实曾考虑过满足某项要求的实现方案，但随后出于它自认为可以接受的理由，最终采用了另一个不满足该要求的方案。我们将这种现象称为“规范满意化”（specification satisficing）。由于智能体是基于自身的理由来接受这些选择的，而现有的自我纠错方法又往往偏向认同这些选择，因此识别和缓解规范满意化行为极具挑战性。我们提出了 SatisFix，该方法引导编码智能体报告这些实现选择及其理由，然后将每个选择与任务描述逐项核对。我们在 DeepSWE 和 SWE-bench Pro 上评估了 SatisFix，采用五个大语言模型作为骨干、两种不同的智能体框架，并与三种自我纠错方法进行了比较。SatisFix 使基础智能体的 pass@1 在 DeepSWE 上平均提升 5.09%，在 SWE-bench Pro 的困难子集上平均提升 7.06%。
tldr: SatisFix 通过引导编码智能体报告实现选择及其理由，并逐项对照任务描述进行核查，有效识别并缓解了“规范满意化”行为，使 pass@1 平均提升 5.09%–7.06%。
en_tdlr: SatisFix mitigates specification satisficing in coding agents by eliciting their implementation choices and underlying reasons, then checking each choice against the task description, improving pass@1 by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-bench Pro.
